conbody.p: Project Settings → Agents chooses how the project's runs authenticate:

ul.li: User account (default) — runs use the launcher's own local CLI sign-in.
API key — overrides local sign-ins; runners inject the workspace's provider API key into the CLI instead.

conbody.p: A workspace admin pastes that key once, in Workspace settings → AI providers, on the provider's card (one Anthropic key serves Claude Code and the Anthropic API). It is saved encrypted and never shown again — only its last four characters — and every runner that picks up a run of an API-key project gets it with the run, members' own machines included, so nobody sets an environment variable. Remove key takes it back; runners then fall back to the variable on their own machine, if it is set there.
